strategies.instructions: Explicitly choose the Slack-hosted MCP setup route. Read this version's SUPPORT.md and provider registration instructions. The documented endpoint is https://mcp.slack.com/mcp using Streamable HTTP, with a fixed eligible Slack app and user OAuth; dynamic client registration is unavailable. Obtain current tool schemas and bind only selected operations through the existing host owners. Report denial or missing prerequisites; do not switch to REST automatically.

No live tool/schema, role readiness, activation, isolation or revocation receipt is retained. This strategy remains guidance-only despite the documented endpoint.

strategies.instructions: Explicitly choose the local Python SlackOperations library for one conversations.history page or one conversations.replies page. Read sdk/python/SLACK.md and this version's SUPPORT.md. The host supplies a dedicated authenticated AsyncClient, exact API base and selected workspace/account binding. Preserve cursor, timestamp and nested message fidelity. Plan channel selection, every required page and thread separately; these two methods do not establish complete weekly coverage. This is an explicit REST choice, never a fallback from MCP denial. Publish tools only after existing host activation/authentication owners bind the operations.
